question: Is it possible to convert a cloze-style questions to a naturally-looking questions?
title: Simple and Effective Semi-Supervised Question Answering
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents discuss converting documents into cloze-style questions for pre-training QA models, but none address converting cloze-style questions into naturally-looking questions. The focus is on generating cloze questions from documents, not transforming cloze questions into natural ones.
